services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Located next to City Hall the Merritt Civic Centre is the ideal location for hosting your meeting, conference or special event. With two auditoriums, a full commercial kitchen, numerous meeting rooms of all sizes, the Civic Centre is versatile and ideal to host functions for as little as ten to as large as 450 people. The Merritt Civic Centre is home to our many fitness programs, and special events. It’s an excellent location to hold seminars, exhibitions, workshops, training, weddings, family reunions, parties, and other networking events. services.name: Bike Pump Track
services.desc: Have you ever wanted to ride or roll to a community event but weren’t sure if you could safely park your bike? Well, dust off that bike, trike, or scooter, and ride to our next event because the City of Merritt is providing FREE bike parking all summer long through our new service, Merritt Moves Bike Valet. Great question - think of it like a coat check service, but cooler and for bikes! You drop off your bike with us and we park it. Merritt Moves Bike Valet is a secure, convenient, and FREE bike parking service operated by City of Merritt staff during our summer events.
